title: Vectors
author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: Recognise, describe and draw the following transformations: reflection of a shape in a vertical or horizontal line; rotation of a shape about the origin, vertices or midpoints of edges of the shape, through multiples of 90°; enlargement of a shape from a centre by a scale factor; translation of a shape by a vector
Describe a translation using a vector represented by column notation, AB or a
Multiply a vector by a scalar
Calculate the magnitude of a vector as √(x² + y²)
Represent vectors by directed line segments
Use the sum and difference of two or more vectors to express given vectors in terms of two coplanar vectors
Use vectors to reason and to solve geometric problems

module_metadata.authors: Disha Garg, Mohammad Aslam & Sagnik Pal
